reference.notes:
I implemented `withoutHost` in `src/utils.ts`. It does exactly what the spec defines: it passes the input to `parseURL` and returns `(parsed.pathname || "/") + parsed.search + parsed.hash`. The spec's edge cases, such as backslashes, leading whitespace and NUL characters, protocol-relative input, `javascript:`/`data:`, `mailto:` and `file:///C:`, all come out of `parseURL` with no extra handling.

All tests pass: 30 in `test/ufo-without-host-confirmed.test.ts`, 41 in the hidden suite, and 495 in the full `npx vitest run`. Type-checking and the linter report no errors. Nothing outside `src/utils.ts` changed.

One small difference from the spec: it says the return type should be inferred, without an explicit `: string`. The stub in `src/utils.ts` already had `: string`, and you asked me to keep the existing signatures, so I left it there. The resulting type is `string` either way.

Tests left failing: none
